correctness.rationale: For finite labelled reflexive symmetric compatibility Q, use simple off-diagonal graph G. Forcing in both directions identifies M successor rows along each Q-edge, so any assignment of κ(G) successor subsets yields 2^{nκ(G)} arbitrary M and A_n=Σ_G2^{nκ(G)}. If M is equivalence, its reflexivity and forcing give Q⊆M, and every choice of Q edges inside M blocks is allowed, giving B_n=Σ_partition 2^{Σ binom(blocksize,2)}. Rank r=n−κ(G) has g_{n,0}=1,g_{n,1}=C(n,2),g_{n,2}=4C(n,3)+3C(n,4); spanning-forest count bounds r≥3 and yields A_n/2^{n²}=1+C(n,2)2^(−n)+g_{n,2}2^(−2n)+O(n^6 2^(−3n)). For B_n, one block contributes 1 and the n partitions (n−1,1) contribute n2^(−n+1); all other partitions have cross-block deficit at least about 3n/2 or n²/8 and sum O(n²2^(−3n/2)). The large-block Erdős–Rényi graph is connected w.h.p., proving conditional dominant defects. Boundary n=1,2 exceptional shapes do not undermine n→∞. Independent brute force from definitions through n=3 confirms A,B=(2,1),(20,3),(736,15). Finite enumeration is only corroboration.
